CustomField.formula: IMAGE( IF( Vigencia_de_cedula__c - TODAY() <= 0, "/img/samples/flag_red.gif", IF( Vigencia_de_cedula__c - TODAY() < 90 , "/img/samples/flag_yellow.gif", IF( Vigencia_de_cedula__c - TODAY() > 90, "/img/samples/flag_green.gif" , "Sin datos"))), "Sin datos" )
CustomField.label: Indicador vigencia de cédula
